arabic_text: أَنَا وَكَافِلُ الْيَتِيمِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ هَكَذَا وَقَالَ: بِإِصْبَعَيْهِ السَّبَّابَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى
english_translation: I and the one who cares for an orphan will be in Paradise like this – and he indicated his index and middle fingers.
question: What does the Prophet (pbuh) mean by 'kafil al-yatim' in this hadith?

options.B: One who cares for an orphan
